title: Microsoft PowerPoint: Assess templates for use with Copilot in Brand Kits
summary: Microsoft PowerPoint's new Template Assessment in Brand Kits helps Brand Managers evaluate and improve templates for better Copilot compatibility, requiring a Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license. It rolls out worldwide from mid to late October 2026. No action needed; organizations should inform Brand Managers.
body:
[What and why]

We’re introducing Template Assessment in Brand Kits. This new capability helps Brand Managers evaluate how well a PowerPoint template will work with Copilot and provides actionable recommendations to help Copilot create more consistent, on-brand presentations.

A Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) license is required.

[Rollout schedule]

- General Availability (Worldwide): Beginning in mid-October 2026 and expected to complete by late October 2026[Impact on your organization]

Who is affected

- Brand Managers who manage PowerPoint templates in Brand KitsPlatforms and services

- Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium)- Microsoft PowerPoint- Brand KitsWhat will happen

- Brand Managers can assess how well a PowerPoint template will work with Copilot.- Template Assessment provides actionable recommendations for improving templates.- Brand Managers can apply the recommendations to help Copilot create more consistent, on-brand presentations.

[Action required and recommendations]

No action is required to prepare for this feature.

We recommend that organizations:

- Inform Brand Managers about Template Assessment.- Encourage Brand Managers to assess PowerPoint templates as part of their Brand Kit setup and management process.Learn more

- Build templates that work well with Copilot | Microsoft Support[Compliance considerations]

No compliance considerations identified. Review as usual for your organization.
